info.description:
REST API test suite for an e-commerce application created as a QA Automation portfolio project.

Test scope:

- Functional API testing
    
- Positive and negative test scenarios
    
- Authentication and authorization
    
- Products
    
- Users
    
- Shopping carts
    
- API response validation
